derivation.rule: every cell is produced by a rule applied to the checked-in catalog; no entry is selected by hand (REQ-9.2). An axis value exists because the catalog contains it, and each cell's representative is the first member in the catalog's own preference order (captured gallery tile, then GUI item, then key).
derivation.formEstablished: catalog-derived: accepted status with no ooxml.gap and no ooxml.requiresCapture. It records what the catalog itself claims and never encodes writer state, so this file cannot drift when the writer changes. Whether a preset's behavior payload is also captured is a finer gate the harness discovers by running the writer.
derivation.boundaryClasses: minimum and maximum are the smallest and largest value the catalog pins for a numeric semantic-JSON path; normal is the most frequently pinned value, ties resolved to the smaller. A path with one pinned value collapses all three classes onto one fixture and says so in the cell note.
derivation.reproducible: derived only from the catalog bytes named below, with no wall-clock timestamp, so two runs over an unchanged catalog are byte-identical.
